A second row at the same USD 4.00 is VPS_Basic_EPYC_74F3 (1 Epyc core shared, 1,024 MB RAM, 12 GB NVMe, 1,000 GB/month bandwidth, 0.5 Gbps port), and USD 5.00 buys 20 GB of NVMe at 1,024 GB/month.

egress.terms: 1,000 GB a month across the Basic VPS family, stated as a plan line; no overage rate and no post-quota policy published on the page read

record.tooling: KVM with root, sold through a WHMCS client area at infofractal.io/clients with a multi-currency selector (USD, CLP, CLF); no API documented on the pages read.
record.chaining: The only South American location among evaluated providers, at USD 2.50 for 1 GB and 1 TB a month, which is worth having as a second continent for a latency probe or a failover front end; 10 GB of NVMe and 1 TB a month mean it relays and does not store.

limits.value: 1,000 GB a month is 33 GB a day, 3 percent of the 1 TB daily transfer ceiling, on a 0.5 Gbps port that would carry far more if the allowance allowed it; the 10 GB disk is the second wall.
